PROCESS: a batched edit script that asserts on a missing anchor aborts before writing, so every earlier edit in the same batch is silently lost. That is how three Hebrew repairs went missing this cycle and were caught only by an independent reviewer. Write each file's edits in its own call, or verify after writing.

PROCESS: an English-only repair pass is a live failure mode here. Hebrew is the site's default locale, so a fix applied to SKILL.md alone reaches the minority of users. Diff EN and HE for every corrected fact before the gates.
